M-CI.NAME: CI quality gate
M-CI.purpose: Run the whole MyGRACE quality gate in one invocation: strict lint, project status, verification coverage and optional trust-gated tests (ROADMAP G3/G4/G5, Wave 3).

type-CoverageReport.PURPOSE: Verification coverage counters and gaps (modules without verification, missing test files).

type-TestsReport.PURPOSE: Scoped test-run counters and trust-refusal information.

type-CiResult.PURPOSE: Gate findings, status snapshot, coverage, optional tests and the ADR-3 exit code.

fn-collectCoverage.PURPOSE: Check module, verification, declared command and test-file coverage.

fn-runCiGate.PURPOSE: The gate itself: lint with strict semantics + status + coverage (+ tests); exported for tests and MCP.

CrossLink.relation: reuses the failure report writer for the optional tests stage

contract.purpose: Single merge/CI gate that answers whether a MyGRACE project is fit to ship.

param.name: options
param.description: Optional module scope, tests flag and allow-commands opt-in.

param.name: result
param.description: Findings, status, coverage, optional tests and exit code.

error.description: Tests were requested but the project is not trusted (exit 2).
Lint, status or coverage findings; exit 1.

notes.note-1: Default mode is read-only: lint strict + status + verification coverage. Project commands run only with --tests and a valid trust record or opt-in.
notes.note-2: Coverage closes the question lint cannot answer: does each module's verification declare existing test files?
notes.note-3: Exit codes follow ADR-3 and are identical in text and JSON modes.
